alignments.note: Rule 51: the waw is rendered by the postpositive *also* of *Remember also*; discontinuous placement under rule 25 is not evidence against it.
Imperative verb.
Rule 16: object marker with no English word spent on the object relation.
Participle noun rendered *Creator*.
Rule 18: suffix rendered by the possessive *thy*.
Preposition.
Rules 15 and 29: the construct noun takes the supplied *the*; the rectum is rendered *of thy youth* with a possessive of its own, so nothing is fronted.
Rule 19: the chain's relational *of* belongs to the nomen rectum; discontinuous around the possessive under rule 25.
Rule 18: suffix rendered *thy*.

Rule 30: `עַד אֲשֶׁר לֹא` is rendered by the single word *before*, which carries the temporal limit, the subordination and the negative's 'not yet', so all three share one unit headed on the governing preposition under rule 23. The competing reading gives *before* to `עַד` alone and marks the relative and negative `unrepresented`; rejected because rule 22 forbids marking a morpheme unrendered whose sense the ASV wrote inside a fused word.
Finite verb.
Construct noun; the chain is rendered attributively under rule 28.
Rule 29: the article stands on the rectum and the phrase's single *the* is fronted before the attributive rendering, so the present article takes it.
Rule 28: the rectum is rendered attributively as *evil*.
Rule 14: waw as *and*.
Rule 44: *draw nigh* is a light verb with its complement, and subtraction leaves the lexeme on *nigh*. The competing reading treats *nigh* as a phrasal particle and heads on *draw*.
Rule 15: the supplied definite article joins the nominal expression it determines.
The relative is rendered by the temporal *when*.
Rule 17: the finite verb takes its subject pronoun and auxiliary, headed on the lexical verb.
Rule 50: the existential heads on the negation word; the possessive *have* is the preposition's under rule 43 and no dummy *there* is written here.
Rule 43: the clause is verbless and the possessive `לְ` is what makes it possessive, so it carries the *have*.
Rule 43: the suffix takes the subject pronoun *I*.
Preposition.
Rule 18: suffix rendered by the object pronoun *them*.
Noun.

review_notes: `עַד אֲשֶׁר לֹא` is read as one fused *before* unit under rule 30, headed on `עַד`; the same phrase recurs at ECC.12.2 and ECC.12.6, each verse decided on its own evidence.
*I have no pleasure* is divided by rule 43: `אַיִן` takes *no*, the possessive `לְ` takes *have*, its suffix takes *I*.
